exact_statement: Determine how large n must be as a function of r >= 2 so that there is an antichain in 2^[n] occupying n-3 distinct ranks and containing at least r members on every occupied rank.
scope_notes: Rounds four and five prove that waiting or resetting lower constants inside the unchanged K4,r9 H/q staircase cannot give a uniform pre-rank-42 seed.

Round six proves only that a one-step affine switch which remains canonical and is asymptotically nonnegative must have combined slope budget alpha+delta at least three; it does not prove such a switch exists.

This round searches literal greedy Macaulay before/after words and Pascal identities at true carry or borrow walls. Because canonical expansion is unique, a claimed switch must either be a real canonical cell change of the actual orbit or explicitly alter the construction interface.

A finite cell census, an artificial word pair, or a budget-three coefficient table is not promotion. A scoped all-parameter no-go or a fully legal switch theorem may count only as a standalone decisive lemma; public promotion additionally requires persistence through the rank-42 suffix interface.
